tasks.title: Register each sim system marker once in PerfBench, not twice
tasks.why: PerfBench.cs:546 opens a recorder for every name in PerfMarkers.Names, then :547 opens one more for each host.Local.World.Systems entry as "TW.Sim.Sys." + type. PerfMarkers.cs:26 now routes ForSystem through M(...), and SimWorld.cs:212 calls ForSystem inside AddSystem before the bench opens, so every system name is already in Names: each system gets two ProfilerRecorders and two Series under one key (New at :482 and Marker at :524 do not dedupe). The bench JSON's series and per_tick_ms blocks (:914, :918) then carry the same key twice; a reader keeps only the last, so the per-system numbers docs/05 is checked against come out of an output with duplicate keys. PerfMarkers.cs:15's comment ("in declaration order") is also stale once system names are appended out of that order.
tasks.done_when: a check that the bench's series/per_tick_ms keys are unique (e.g. json.load with an object_pairs_hook that refuses a repeat) over a fresh bench run, plus no TW.Sim.Sys.* name registered twice

tasks.title: Make the two FactionRoster mask tests able to fail
tasks.why: FactionRosterTests.cs:193 asserts OrderGroup.Of(a) & OrderGroup.All != 0, but OrderGroup.cs:50 returns Line for every id it does not name, so no archetype can ever fail it. FactionRosterTests.cs:135 asserts each faction MayCall(..., HeBarrage), which after FactionRoster.cs:116 (EveryAbility = ~1u) is true for every id 1..31 but 12, so it no longer proves the barrage bit specifically is in the mask. Both lines are green but guard nothing: a mask regression would pass unnoticed.
tasks.done_when: the rewritten tests assert the whole mask against the literals 0xFFFFEFFE for every faction but Brass and 0xFFFFFFFE for Brass (from FactionRoster.cs:116-119), and go red when FactionOnly is set to 0
